senses.gloss: to relax, be weak, prostrated (cmp. חָלָה).—V. חַלָּשׁ.

[to round, smoothen, denom. חֵלֶשׁ smooth stone; (cmp. חֵלֶק) ballot; fr. which חָלַשׁ] to cast a lot; to assign. Pesik. Zakh., p. 22ᵃ expl. ויחלש, (Ex. XVIII, 13) הפיל עליהן גורלות he (Joshua) cast lots over them (for their destruction).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 9:4">Arakh. IX, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Arakhin 31b:80">31ᵇ</cite>) <he>שיהא חוֹלֵשׁ … ללשכה</he> (Mish. ed. <he>בלשכה</he>) that he might assign his redeeming money to the Temple fund (deposit it there, to assert his privilege of redemption).
